name: 91105 · Pasadena, CA
findings: ZIP 91105 (Pasadena) has 204 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91105 (Pasadena) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91105 (Pasadena) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
